Preserve all mapped tests and many-to-many context while deduplicating canonical records.

findings.assessment: The accepted committed-source switch and historical read-only journey is absent. The header offers only checkout-local Workstream and Refresh; _capture_view admits working-tree data, all reset_for_work calls use working-tree, and the source badge never exposes an immutable selected revision. Connect the existing source inspector to app-level source selection, reset route/caches on explicit source change, and make committed sources noneditable.

The form test never enters historical mode.
